connector.name: MCP Health Monitor by oaslananka (oaslananka-health-monitor-mcp)
connector.registryDescription: Monitor MCP, CI, and HTTP targets with health history, TLS expiry, assertions, and diagnostics
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package health-monitor-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oaslananka account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HEALTH_MONITOR_DB
env.description: Custom path for the SQLite database

env.name: HEALTH_MONITOR_AUTO_CHECK
env.description: Set to '1' to enable background scheduled checks

env.name: HEALTH_MONITOR_RETENTION_DAYS
env.description: Number of days to retain health check history

env.name: HEALTH_MONITOR_MAX_CONCURRENCY
env.description: Maximum concurrent scheduled and interactive server checks

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: Optional GitHub token with Actions read access for private repositories and higher API rate limits

env.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
env.description: Optional GitLab token with read access to private projects, pipelines, jobs, and traces

env.name: HEALTH_MONITOR_GITLAB_BASE_URL_ALLOWLIST
env.description: Comma-separated self-hosted GitLab HTTPS origins allowed for monitoring

env.name: HEALTH_MONITOR_HTTP_TARGET_ALLOWLIST
env.description: Comma-separated private HTTP(S) origins allowed only in the full runtime profile
